welcome.headline: Perform a story with AI — one that truly begins and ends.
welcome.lede: You are not chatting with an AI; you are staging a story together — with causes, momentum and an ending. Start from a premise, and the world remembers every choice.

agency.title: Freedom
agency.description: No fixed script — describe actions in plain words

duet.title: Duet
duet.description: The AI is your scene partner

ending.title: Ending
ending.description: Stories end instead of dragging on

welcome.settingsHint: Language, theme, API, dice and limits all live in Settings
welcome.newCycleBudgetDescription: Set the maximum initialization budget for this run in both CNY and USD. The unused currency will remain available.
welcome.newCyclePreparationOnly: This step saves the run and its frozen initialization request. It does not contact the model. You can review the run, then explicitly send the initialization request from Run management.
welcome.newCycleBudgetAck: I confirm these CNY and USD spending limits for this run.
welcome.newCycleBudgetInvalid: Each limit must be between 0 and 9,223,372,036.854775807, with at most 9 fractional digits.

runs.title: Existing runs
runs.description: Browse saved runs without opening their records or sending a request.
runs.empty: No saved runs are registered yet.
runs.filterEmpty: No runs on this page need attention.
runs.dispatchInitializationWarning: This sends a model request and may incur a charge. Continue only when the status says dispatch is available.
runs.initializationMissing: No initialization record was found. This run may need another recovery path.
runs.initializationInProgress: Initialization has started or claimed dispatch. Refresh its status; do not send it again.
runs.initializationNeedsRetry: The previous initialization failed or has an uncertain result. Retrying creates a new durable request identity and does not send a model request yet.
runs.initializationReady: Initialization is complete. Refresh the run list to continue.
runs.scanIncomplete: Legacy discovery is incomplete. Run another explicit scan to continue.
runs.reconcileBillingDescription: Merge verified charges from the old run scope. If historical budget limits conflict, choose the final CNY and USD limits for this run. No model request is sent.
runs.invalidLimits: Enter both limits as non-negative decimal amounts with at most 9 fractional digits.
runs.deletionPending: Run deletion is still in progress
runs.backupNotice: Database backups may retain historical bytes. Deletion is not secure erasure.
runs.deleteBlocked: This run has unsettled billing requests. Confirming deletion will also permanently remove those requests and their billing records.
runs.identityRepairRequired: This run's memory identity mapping is inconsistent. Deletion is disabled until the stored identity is repaired.
runs.deleteAck: I confirm permanent deletion of all local data for this run, including unsettled billing requests
runs.deleteImpact: This removes the run transcript, recovery sidecars, run-scoped memory, entities and all run-scoped billing records, including unsettled requests.
runs.keepsDescription: Model profiles and API keys, registered prices and limits, application settings
runs.bindDescription: The old save did not record its original profile. Future requests will use this profile; past costs are not repriced.
runs.bindAck: I confirm future requests will use the selected profile

memorySettings.explanation: These uncalibrated development defaults apply to new runs. Existing runs keep their frozen policy. Invalid combinations are rejected as a whole.
memorySettings.inherited: Unset fields inherit application version {version}. Select a field to override it for this scenario.
memorySettings.algorithmHint: Only parameters used by the selected algorithm are editable. Exponential uses decay rate; segmented uses half-life; no-decay uses neither.
memorySettings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number in every active parameter field.
memorySettings.saved: Policy saved. Existing runs were not recalculated.
memorySettings.error: Could not load or save the policy. Your current edits are preserved; reload before resolving a version conflict.

billing.title: Run cost limits and model price
billing.explanation: CNY and USD limits are independent. Costs stay in the provider's currency; no conversion or shared total is used. Manually entered prices are estimates, not a statement of your provider bill.
billing.referenceHint: Initial suggestions use 2,000,000 input and 500,000 output tokens for each registered currency price. Edit either amount before saving.
billing.priceReady: A price is registered for the selected provider, route and model.
billing.priceMissing: Register a price before sending a paid request.
billing.priceImmutableNote: Registered price versions cannot be edited. Add a new version when prices change; prior requests keep their frozen version.
billing.goPeakSchedule: These are {provider} peak prices. Regular prices above are off-peak. The official UTC windows are Monday–Friday 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00; for {timeZone}, this week's local windows are {windows}. {holidayNote}
billing.deepseekHolidayNote: DeepSeek also treats Chinese public holidays as off-peak. Its verified holiday calendar currently covers 2026 only; uncovered years use peak prices conservatively.
billing.noUsage: No requests have been billed in this run.
billing.incomplete: {count} request(s) have incomplete usage or costs.
billing.warning: {currency} has reached {percent}% of this run's limit.
billing.settlementPending: Provider usage is saved, but local billing settlement needs recovery. Recovery recalculates usage into the local ledger without contacting the provider API. Diagnostic:
billing.settlementConflict: Conflicting usage was received; the first record was preserved and the saved result will not be overwritten. Diagnostic:
billing.backfillPreview: Saved usage will be priced with its original frozen version ({priceVersion}): {amount} {currency}.
billing.backfillUnavailable: Only complete saved usage can be recovered. No provider request will be sent.
billing.balanceUnsupported: Balance queries are not connected for this provider.
billing.balanceCacheHint: Explicit queries are cached for five minutes and backed off after failures. This does not change the local budget.

errors.settlementBacklog: Pending settlement recovery reached its safety limit. Retry existing settlements before sending new requests.
